```yaml
name: Publish Widget

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
    paths:
      - 'packages/warp-widget/**'
  pull_request:
    paths:
      - 'packages/warp-widget/**'

jobs:
  publish:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      contents: read
      packages: write
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup Node.js
        uses: useblacksmith/setup-node@v5
        with:
          node-version: 20
          cache: 'npm'
          cache-dependency-path: 'packages/warp-widget/package-lock.json'

      - name: Install dependencies
        working-directory: packages/warp-widget
        run: npm ci

      - name: Run tests
        working-directory: packages/warp-widget
        run: npm test

      - name: Build package
        working-directory: packages/warp-widget
        run: npm run build

      - name: Publish to npm
        if: github.event_name == 'push' && github.ref == 'refs/heads/main'
        working-directory: packages/warp-widget
        run: |
          echo "//registry.npmjs.org/:_authToken=${{ secrets.NPM_TOKEN }}" > .npmrc
          npm publish --access public
        env:
          NODE_AUTH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.NPM_TOKEN }}
```
